# Whiskey Ranch

> Bar and grill with bourbon, cold beer, snacks, and live music every weekend at 1112 Van Buren Avenue on the Oxford Square in Oxford, Mississippi. Opened February 2025 by Backwoods Hospitality Group. Walk-ins welcome.

Phone: (844) 643-3855 | Address: 1112 Van Buren Avenue, Oxford, MS 38655

- [Home](https://www.whiskeyranchoxford.com/): Overview of the bar and grill.
- [Menu](https://www.whiskeyranchoxford.com/menu): Food, beer, and liquor menu with prices: appetizers, main snacks, grilled cheese, beer, vodka, bourbon, tequila.
- [Our Story](https://www.whiskeyranchoxford.com/about): The meaning of the name and the February 2025 opening.
- [Gallery](https://www.whiskeyranchoxford.com/gallery): Photos of the bar, the band, the patio, and the crowd.

## Hours

- Monday to Friday: 4:00pm to 1:00am
- Saturday: 11:00am to 1:00am
- Sunday: 11:00am to 9:00pm

## Menu

Prices in USD. Full menu: https://www.whiskeyranchoxford.com/menu

### Appetizers
- Loaded Fries (Hand cut fries, cheddar cheese, bacon bits, ranch & green onions): $14
- Truffle Fries (Hand cut fries, parmesan, truffle oil): $14
- Mozzarella Sticks (Hand battered mozzarella served with marinara & parmesan): 3 for $8 / 5 for $12

### Main Snacks
- Chicken Tenders (In-house breaded tenders served with fries & honey mustard): 3 for $11 / 5 for $15
- Sausage Plate (Country pleasin' sausage, cheddar, pepper jack, mozzarella with pickled onions, dijon mustard & crackers): $13
- Chicken Sandwich (Fried or grilled chicken breast topped with provolone, tomato & lettuce, served with fries): $15

### Grilled Cheese
- Bad Motherf*cker (Three fried mozzarella sticks, bacon, cheddar, ranch dressing): $16
- The Magnificent (Fried egg, smoked gouda, provolone, bacon, honey-sriracha sauce): $16
- More Cheese Please (Mozzarella, provolone, pepper jack, cheddar): $16
- Cuban Melt (Pulled pork, pickles, mustard, with melted swiss & provolone): $16

### Beer
- Domestics, $5: Michelob Ultra, Miller Lite, Coors Banquet, Blue Moon
- Imported, $6: Corona, Dos Equis, Heineken, Stella

## FAQ

- Where is Whiskey Ranch? 1112 Van Buren Avenue, Oxford, MS 38655, on the historic Oxford Square. Look for the barrel out front.
- Is there live music? Yes, every weekend on the Oxford Square. To book the band for an event, call (844) 643-3855 or email Info@backwoodshospitalitygroup.com.
- Do I need a reservation? No. Walk-ins are welcome every night the bar is open.
- Is there parking? Whiskey Ranch is an easy walk from Square parking and the University of Mississippi campus.
- Do you host private parties? Call (844) 643-3855 or email Info@backwoodshospitalitygroup.com.
- What is the age policy? You must be 21 or older to purchase or consume alcohol, per Mississippi law.
